function u1.calculateRawMoveVector(p44: table, p45: userdata, p46: vector) -- Line: 481
    -- upvalues: Workspace (copy), VRService (copy), getGamepadRightThumbstickPosition (copy)
    local CurrentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera;

    if not CurrentCamera then
        return p46;
    end;

    local CFrame2 = CurrentCamera.CFrame;

    if VRService.VREnabled and p45.RootPart then
        VRService:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head);
        local EstimatedVRTorsoFrame = p44:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame();

        if (CurrentCamera.Focus.Position - CFrame2.Position).Magnitude < 3 then
            CFrame2 = CFrame2 * EstimatedVRTorsoFrame;
        else
            CFrame2 = CurrentCamera.CFrame * (EstimatedVRTorsoFrame.Rotation + EstimatedVRTorsoFrame.Position * CurrentCamera.HeadScale);
        end;
    end;

    if p45:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
        local _, _, _, v47, v48, v49, _, _, v50, _, _, v47 = CFrame2:GetComponents();

        if v50 >= 1 or v50 <= -1 then
            v49 = -v48 * math.sign(v50);
        end;

        local math_sqrt_ret = math.sqrt(v47 * v47 + v49 * v49);

        return Vector3.new((v47 * p46.X + v49 * p46.Z) / math_sqrt_ret, 0, (v47 * p46.Z - v49 * p46.X) / math_sqrt_ret);
    end;

    if not VRService.VREnabled then
        return CFrame2:VectorToWorldSpace(p46);
    end;

    local Vector3_new_ret = Vector3.new(p46.X, 0, p46.Z);

    if Vector3_new_ret.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0);
    end;

    local v51 = -getGamepadRightThumbstickPosition().Y * 1.3962634015954636;
    local math_atan2_ret = math.atan2(-Vector3_new_ret.X, -Vector3_new_ret.Z);
    local _, v52, _ = CFrame2:ToEulerAnglesYXZ();

function ragdoll(p314)
    -- upvalues: Util (copy), Effects (copy)
    local viewmodels = p314.values.viewmodels;
    local Humanoid = p314.instance:FindFirstChild("Humanoid");
    local v315 = viewmodels:Clone();
    local v316 = nil;

    for _, child in v315:GetChildren() do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            local v317 = child;

            for _, v in child:GetTags() do
                v317:RemoveTag(v);
            end;

            if v317.PrimaryPart then
                for _, descendant in v317:GetDescendants() do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        descendant.CollisionGroup = "ragdoll";
                        descendant.CanCollide = true;
                        descendant.CanQuery = false;

                        if descendant.Anchored then
                            descendant.Anchored = false;
                            Util.weld_c(v317.PrimaryPart, descendant);
                        end;
                    elseif descendant:IsA("Light") or descendant:IsA("Sound") then
                        descendant:Destroy();
                    end;
                end;

                v317.Parent = game.Workspace;
                Effects.mark_for_killcam(v317);
                Util.debris(v317, 5);

                if Humanoid and Humanoid:GetAttribute("LookImpulse") then
                    local v318 = v317.PrimaryPart.AssemblyMass * 2.5;
                    local Attribute = Humanoid:GetAttribute("LookImpulse");

                    if not Attribute then
                        local v319 = math.random() * 2 - 1;
                        local v320 = math.random() * 2 - 1;
                        local v321 = math.random() * 2 - 1;
                        Attribute = Vector3.new(v319, v320, v321);
                    end;

                    v317.PrimaryPart:ApplyImpulse(Attribute * 5 * v318);
                end;
            else
                for _, child2 in v317:GetChildren() do
                    local v322 = v315:FindFirstChild(child2.Name);

                    if v322 then
                        child2.Parent = v322;
                        Util.weld_c(child2.PrimaryPart, v322);
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    for _, child in v315:GetChildren() do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") and (child.Transparency ~= 1 or child.Name == "head") then
            local v323 = child;

            for _, descendant in child:GetDescendants() do
                if descendant:IsA("Model") then
                    local v324 = descendant;

                    for _, v in descendant:GetTags() do
                        v324:RemoveTag(v);
                    end;
                elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Anchored then
                    descendant.Anchored = false;
                    Util.weld_c(v323, descendant);
                elseif descendant.Name == "RagdollConstraint" then
                    descendant.Enabled = true;
                elseif descendant:IsA("Light") or descendant:IsA("Sound") then
                    descendant:Destroy();
                end;
            end;

            v323.Parent = game.Workspace;
            Effects.mark_for_killcam(v323);
            v323.Anchored = false;
            v323.CanQuery = false;
            v323.CanCollide = true;
            v323.CollisionGroup = "ragdoll";
            v323.Transparency = v323:GetAttribute("OriginalTransparency") or 0;
            v323.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;
            Util.debris(v323, 5);

            if v323.Name == "torso" then
                v316 = v323;
            elseif v323.Name == "head" then
                for _, child2 in v323:GetChildren() do
                    if child2:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        child2:Destroy();
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    if Humanoid and Humanoid:GetAttribute("LookImpulse") then
        local v325 = v316.AssemblyMass * 5;
        v316:ApplyImpulse(((Humanoid:GetAttribute("LookImpulse") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) * 5 * v325);
    end;
end;

function is_moving(p356, p357)
    -- upvalues: Util (copy)
    local Humanoid = p356.instance.Humanoid;
    local MoveDirection = Humanoid.MoveDirection;
    local HumanoidRootPart = p356.instance.HumanoidRootPart;
    local v358 = os.clock() - p356.values.reposition < 0.2;

    if p356.states.controller:get() ~= nil and (MoveDirection.X ~= 0 or (MoveDirection.Z ~= 0 or v358)) and p356.states.vault:get() == 0 then
        if v358 and p356.values.custom_movement then
            return true;
        end;

        if not (p356.values.falling:get() or (HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p356.states.climbing:get() >= 1)) then
            return true;
        end;

        if p356.states.climbing:get() > 1 and workspace:Spherecast(HumanoidRootPart.Position, 1, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 2, p356.values.ray_params) then
            return true;
        end;

        if p356.states.climbing:get() == 1 then
            local is_moving_forward_or_backward = Util.is_moving_forward_or_backward;
            local MoveDirection2 = Humanoid.MoveDirection;
            local X = p356.states.look:get().X;
            local Z = p356.states.look:get().Z;

            if is_moving_forward_or_backward(MoveDirection2, Vector3.new(X, 0, Z).Unit) ~= 0 then
                return true;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    return false;
end;

function render_walking(u359, p360, p361)
    -- upvalues: Util (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), u6 (copy)
    local Humanoid = u359.instance.Humanoid;

        end;
    end;

    u359.values.last_move = u363;
    local v367 = p361:VectorToObjectSpace(u363);
    u359.values.move_direction = v367;
    local v368, _, _ = u359.values.viewmodels.head.CFrame:ToOrientation();
    local v369 = v368 * 0.2 * u359.values.reverse_negative:get();

                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
                });
            end;

            u234.LockedFrame.Visible = true;
        end;

        local function update_votes() -- Line: 1847
            -- upvalues: u234 (copy), i (copy), LocalPlayer (ref)
            if not u234:FindFirstChild("Frame") then
                return;
            end;

            local v236 = 0;

                if v2:GetAttribute("BannedMap") == i and v2.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                    v236 = v236 + 1;
                end;
            end;

            if v236 <= 0 then
                u234.Frame.Dot.Visible = false;

                return;
            end;

            u234.Frame.Dot.Amount.Text = v236;
            u234.Frame.Dot.Visible = true;
        end;

        local u237 = i;

        for _, child in game.Teams:GetChildren() do
            ban_phase_maid:add(Util.watch_attribute(child, "MapBans", v235));
        end;

        ban_phase_maid:add(Net.on_connect(function(p238) -- Line: 1867
            -- upvalues: Util (ref), update_votes (copy)
            ban_phase_maid:add(Util.watch_attribute(p238, "BannedMap", update_votes));

        UI.on_click(u234, function() -- Line: 1873
            -- upvalues: u234 (copy), LocalPlayer (ref), u237 (copy), Net (ref)
            if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("BanPhase") ~= "Maps" then
                return;
            end;

            if u234.LockedFrame.Visible then

            end;

            end;

                LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("BannedMap", nil);
                Net.send("ban_map", nil);

                return;
            end;

            LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("BannedMap", u237);
            Net.send("ban_map", u237);
        end);
        ban_phase_maid:add(u234);
    end;
end;

function owns_item(p332, p333)
    -- upvalues: Admin (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), Items (copy), Globals (copy), Data (copy)
    if Admin.is_admin:get() and not p333 then
        return true;
    end;

    local v334 = typeof(p332) == "string" and { p332 } or p332;

    if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Subscribed") and not p333 then
        local v335 = true;

        for _, v in v334 do
            local _item_class = Items.get_item_class(v);

            if not (_item_class and table.find(Globals.item_types, _item_class.loadout_type)) then
                v335 = false;
                break;
            end;
        end;

        if v335 then
            return true;
        end;
    end;

    if Data.owned == nil then
        return false;
    end;

    for _, v in v334 do
        if Data.owned[v] ~= true and (typeof(Data.owned[v]) ~= "table" or not Data.owned[v].owned) then
            return false;
        end;
    end;

    return true;
end;

function owns_attachment(p336, p337, p338)
    -- upvalues: Admin (copy), Items (copy), Data (copy)
    if Admin.is_admin:get() and not p338 then
        return true;
    end;

    local v339;

    if Items.get_item_class(p337).loadout_type == "charm" then
        if Data.owned[p337] == true then
            v339 = true;
        else
            v339 = typeof(Data.owned[p337]) == "table" and Data.owned[p337].owned or Data.owned[p336] and Data.owned[p336][p337];
        end;
    else
        v339 = Data.owned[p336] and Data.owned[p336][p337];
    end;

    return v339;
end;

function is_attachment_valid(p340, p341)
    -- upvalues: Items (copy)
    local _item_class = Items.get_item_class(p340);
    local _item_class2 = Items.get_item_class(p341);

    return Items.get_item_model(p340) and (_item_class and (_item_class2 and (_item_class2.items[p340] or _item_class2.loadout_type == "charm"))) and true or false;
end;

for _, v in Globals.attachment_types do
    u1[v] = State.new(nil);

function setup_spawning()
    -- upvalues: UI (copy), Timer (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), Util (copy), Data (copy), u1 (copy), Loading (copy), Net (copy), StateObject (copy), Input (copy), Maid (copy), Map (copy), State (copy)
    local u397 = UI.get("SpawnButton");
    local u398 = UI.get("SpawnFrame");

        -- upvalues: LocalPlayer (ref), Util (ref), u397 (copy), u398 (copy)

            return;
        end;

        local v399 = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RespawnStamp") - Util.os_time();

        if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CanDrone") then
            v399 = v399 - 30;
        end;

        if v399 > 0 then
            u397.Cooldown.Text = `{v399} Seconds`;
            u397.LockedFrame.Visible = true;
        else
            u397.Cooldown.Text = "";
            u397.LockedFrame.Visible = false;
        end;

        u397.Visible = v399 < 1000;
        local Key = u398.Key;
        local v400;

        if v399 < 1000 then
            v400 = u398.Key:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiBase2d");
        else
            v400 = false;
        end;

        Key.Visible = v400;
    end, nil, "global");
    local SpectateInterface = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SpectateInterface);

    local function spawn_function(p402) -- Line: 3403
        -- upvalues: Data (ref), u1 (ref), Loading (ref), Net (ref)
        local table_find_ret = table.find(Data.classes, u1.chosen_class:get());
        Loading.start_medium();
        game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position);
        local v403, v404 = Net.get("spawn", table_find_ret, p402);

        if v403 then
            u1.enabled:set(false);

            return;
        end;

        u1.current_tab:set("loadout");
        Loading.stop_medium();
        task.spawn(display_notification, v404, nil);
    end;

            return;
        end;

        if game.Workspace:GetAttribute("Gamemode") ~= "Bomb" or not (LocalPlayer.Team and LocalPlayer.Team:GetAttribute("Attack")) then
            spawn_function();

            return;
        end;

        Loading.transition();
        local v405 = StateObject.get("Player", LocalPlayer).states.viewing:get();

        if v405 then
            require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ObservationsInterface).exit_observation_tool(nil, StateObject.get(v405.Name, v405));
        end;

        u1.enabled:set(true);
        SpectateInterface.enabled:set(false);
        u1.current_tab:set("spawn_location");
    end;

    u1.spawn_function_button = spawn_function_button;

function get_profile_data(p532)
    -- upvalues: LocalPlayer (copy), Net (copy), Data (copy)
    local v533 = {};

    if p532 ~= LocalPlayer then
        return Net.get("request_profile_data", p532);
    end;

    v533.xp = Data.xp;
    v533.ranked = Data.ranked;
    v533.match_history = {};
    v533.stats = {
        kills = 0,
        deaths = 0,
        wins = 0,
        losses = 0
    };

    for i = #Data.match_history, 1, -1 do
        local v534 = Data.match_history[i];

        if #v533.match_history < 10 then
            table.insert(v533.match_history, 1, v534);
        end;

        local v535 = v534.stats[tostring(p532.UserId)];
        local v536;

        if v534.match_type == "Custom" or not v535 then
            v536 = i;
        else
            if v534.winner == v535.team then
                local stats = v533.stats;
                stats.wins = stats.wins + 1;
            elseif v534.winner ~= nil then
                local stats = v533.stats;
                stats.losses = stats.losses + 1;
            end;

            local stats = v533.stats;
            stats.kills = stats.kills + v535.kills;
            local stats2 = v533.stats;
            stats2.deaths = stats2.deaths + v535.deaths;
            v536 = i;
        end;
    end;

    return v533;
end;

function can_climb(p71)
    -- upvalues: Util (copy)
    if not p71.values.inputs.enabled:get() then
        return;
    end;

    if p71.instance.Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and (p71.states.walk_state:get() ~= "prone" and (p71.states.vault:get() == 0 and (p71.states.climbing:get() == 0 and not p71.values.prone_debounce))) then

        local HumanoidRootPart = p71.instance.HumanoidRootPart;

        local u74 = nil;

        end;

        Util.parts_on_ray(v72.CFrame.Position, v72.CFrame.LookVector * 5, {}, function(p75) -- Line: 510
            -- upvalues: u73 (ref), u74 (ref)
            local Instance2 = p75.Instance;

                return (Instance2:GetAttribute("Soft") or (Instance2.Parent:GetAttribute("Soft") or (Instance2.CanCollide ~= true or Instance2.Transparency >= 1))) and true or false;
            end;

            u73 = Instance2;
            u74 = p75.Normal;

            return false;
        end);

        if u73 then
            local start = u73.start;
            local finish = u73.finish;
            local final = u73.final;

            if (start.WorldCFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 2 and Util.normal_to_face(u74, u73) == Enum.NormalId.Front then

            end;

            if (final.WorldCFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 2 then

            end;
        end;
    end;
end;

function setup_meleeing(u119)

    local os_clock_ret = os.clock();
    u119.values.camera:get();

        -- upvalues: u119 (copy), os_clock_ret (ref), Input (ref), u118 (ref), Items (ref), Util (ref)

            return;
        end;

        if p120 and (os_clock_ret2 - os_clock_ret > 0.7 and not u119.values.equip_debounce:get()) then
            u119.states.running:set(false);

            if equipped and Input.current_device:get() == "console" then
                if equipped.states.sights and equipped.states.sights:get() then

                end;

                if equipped.states.aiming and equipped.states.aiming:get() then
                    return;
                end;
            end;

            for _, v in u118 do
                local u121 = u119.values.Items:FindFirstChild(v, true) or u119.values.viewmodels:FindFirstChild(v, true);

                if u121 then
                    if u119.states.holding:get() == u121 then
                        return;
                    end;

                    if holding.melee == nil then
                        local _item = Items.get_item(u121);

                        if _item:equip_item(u119) ~= false then
                            u119.states.holding:set(u121);

                            while u119.values.equip_debounce:get() do
                                u119.values.equip_debounce:wait();
                            end;

                            if u119.states.holding:get() == u121 then
                                os_clock_ret = os_clock_ret2;
                                _item:send_melee();
                            end;

                            return;
                        end;

                        Util.ov(function() -- Line: 884
                            -- upvalues: Util (ref), _item (copy), u119 (ref), u121 (copy)

                            }).Completed:Wait();

                                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

                        end, _item.button)();
                    end;
                end;
            end;

            if holding and holding.melee then

                    return;

                if holding.safety == nil or not holding.safety:get() then

                end;
            end;

            if equipped and (equipped.melee and equipped.can_melee ~= false) then

            end;
        end;
    end);
end;

function can_interact(p245)
    -- upvalues: StateObject (copy), Util (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), Interact (copy)
    if not p245.values.inputs.enabled:get() then
        return;
    end;

    if p245.instance.Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and (p245.states.vault:get() == 0 and not p245.values.prone_debounce) then
        p245.values.camera:get();
        local _ = p245.instance.HumanoidRootPart;

        for i, v in StateObject.get_all("Interact") do
            local v246 = Util.ownership(v.owner:get()) >= 3 and i.Name ~= "Defuser" and (p245.values.Items:FindFirstChild(i.Name) or p245.values.viewmodels:FindFirstChild(i.Name));

            if not v246 then

                    v246 = LocalPlayer.Team:GetAttribute("Attack") and not StateObject.get("Defuser", i).states.planted:get();
                else
                    v246 = false;
                end;
            end;

            if v246 and (i.Parent == game.Workspace and (Interact.can_interact(LocalPlayer, i) and Util.can_ray_reach(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, i:GetPivot().Position, { i, p245.instance, p245.values.viewmodels }))) then
                return i;
            end;
        end;

        return nil;
    end;
end;

function render_running(p257)
    -- upvalues: u1 (copy), Data (copy)
    local inputs = p257.values.inputs;
    local v258 = p257.states.walk_state:get();
    local equipped = p257.values.equipped;

    if (inputs:get("run"):holding() or p257.values.running_toggled) and (p257.values.move_vector and (p257.values.move_vector.Magnitude > 0.5 and (equipped.states.sights == nil or not equipped.states.sights:get())) and (p257.values.walking:get() and (p257.values.move_direction.Z <= -0.5 and (p257.states.climbing:get() == 0 and (p257.states.speed_multiplier:get() >= 1 and (p257.states.vault:get() == 0 and not (p257.values.equip_debounce:get() or (p257.values.prone_debounce or p257.values.equipped ~= nil and (p257.values.equipped.states.melee ~= nil and p257.values.equipped.states.melee:get()))))))) and (p257.values.holding == nil or p257.values.holding.can_run ~= false))) then
        if v258 == "stand" or v258 == "prone" and not u1.tightspace(p257, CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)) or v258 == "crouch" and not u1.tightspace(p257, CFrame.new(0, 1.15, 0)) then
            p257.states.running:set(true);

            if Data.settings.auto_vault and p257.values.can_vault then
                p257.values.can_vault = false;
                task.spawn(u1.vault, p257);
            end;
        else
            p257.states.running:set(false);
            p257.values.running_toggled = false;
        end;
    else
        p257.states.running:set(false);
        p257.values.running_toggled = false;
    end;

    if inputs:get("slow_walk").key then
        if not Data.settings.toggle_slow_walk then
            if inputs:get("slow_walk"):holding() and p257.states.running:get() == false then
                p257.states.walking:set(true);

                return;
            end;

            p257.states.walking:set(false);
        end;
    else
        local v259 = p257.values.move_vector and (p257.values.move_vector.Magnitude or 0) or 0;

        if v259 > 0 and (v259 <= 0.5 and p257.states.running:get() == false) then
            p257.states.walking:set(true);

            return;
        end;

        p257.states.walking:set(false);
    end;
end;

function render_climbing(p271, p272)

    return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d", os_date_ret.year, os_date_ret.month, os_date_ret.day, os_date_ret.hour, os_date_ret.min);

    local v28 = p26.states.ads:get();

    if p27 then
        local workspace_CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera;

            FieldOfView = workspace_CurrentCamera:GetAttribute("OriginalFOV") / p26.states.zoom:get()
        });
        Util.tween(UI.get("RedDot").UIStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
            Transparency = 1
        });

        if ScopePart then
            ScopePart:SetAttribute("OriginalMaterial", ScopePart.Material.Name);

            if ScopePart.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
                ScopePart.Material = Enum.Material.Glass;
            end;

            ScopePart:SetAttribute("PreviousScopeTransparency", ScopePart.Transparency);
            ScopePart.Transparency = math.max(0.011, ScopePart.Transparency);
        end;

        local ScopeTint = p26.instance:FindFirstChild("ScopeTint", true);

        if ScopeTint then
            ScopeTint.Transparency = ScopePart == nil and 0.8 or 0.3;
        end;

        UI.hook_world_billboards("sights", function(p29) -- Line: 201
            -- upvalues: Util (ref)
            Util.tween(p29, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
                GroupTransparency = 0.7,
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.9)
            });
        end);

        return;
    end;

    local workspace_CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera;
    Util.tween(workspace_CurrentCamera, TweenInfo.new(v28, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
        FieldOfView = workspace_CurrentCamera:GetAttribute("OriginalFOV")
    });
    Util.tween(UI.get("RedDot").UIStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
        Transparency = 0.5
    });
    local ScopePart = p26.instance:FindFirstChild("ScopePart", true);

    if ScopePart and ScopePart:GetAttribute("OriginalMaterial") then
        ScopePart.Material = Enum.Material[ScopePart:GetAttribute("OriginalMaterial")];
        ScopePart.Transparency = ScopePart:GetAttribute("PreviousScopeTransparency") or 0;
    end;

    local ScopeTint = p26.instance:FindFirstChild("ScopeTint", true);

    if ScopeTint then
        ScopeTint.Transparency = 1;
    end;

    UI.unhook_world_billboards("sights");

    for _, v in UI.get_world_billboards() do
        Util.tween(v, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
            GroupTransparency = 0,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        });
    end;
end;

function u1.auto_shoot_check(p84, p85) -- Line: 569
    -- upvalues: UI (copy), Util (copy), StateObject (copy)
    local os_clock_ret = os.clock();

    if os_clock_ret - p84.auto_shoot_dt > 0.25 then
        p84.auto_shoot_dt = os_clock_ret;

        if UI.get("Flash").Frame.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then
            return;
        end;

        local owner = p84.owner;
        local _shoot_look = p84:get_shoot_look();
        local v86 = CFrame.new(Util.validate_position(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, _shoot_look.Position, owner.values.ray_params)) * _shoot_look.Rotation;

        for _, v in p84:ray_damage(v86.Position, v86.LookVector * 500, { owner.values.viewmodels, owner.instance }, nil, true) do
            local Instance2 = v.Instance;

            if v.HitHum then
                p84:input_shoot(true);

                return;
            end;

            if Instance2 and Instance2.Transparency < 1 then
                local _breakable_instance = Util.get_breakable_instance(Instance2);

                if _breakable_instance and Util.ownership(StateObject.get("Breakable", _breakable_instance).owner:get()) == 0 then
                    p84:input_shoot(true);

                    return;
                end;
            end;
        end;

        if p84.shoot_hold and not (p84.inputs:get("shoot"):holding() or p84.inputs:get("shoot_joystick"):holding()) then
            p84:input_shoot(false);
        end;
    end;
end;

        if p87.ads_hold and not (p87.reload_thread.running or (p87.meleeing or (owner.states.running:get() or (owner.values.prone_debounce or owner.values.equip_debounce:get())))) then

            end;
        end;
    end;

    end;
end;

function u1.equip(p137, p138, p139) -- Line: 956
    local _absolute = p138.values.cframes:get("arm1"):get_absolute("equipped");
    p138.values.cframes:get("arm2"):get_absolute("equipped");
    local Root = p137.instance:FindFirstChild("Root");

    if Root == nil then
        return;
    end;

    if p139 == true then
        p137:unholster(p138);
        p138.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_absolute("equipped", true);
        p137.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(_absolute).Completed:Wait();
        p137.sound.Equip(Root);
        p137.cframes:get(Root):set_pivot("equipped");
        p137.cframes:get(Root).pivot_time = 0.2;
        p138.values.cframes:get("arm1"):set_pivot("equipped");
        local safety = p137.safety;
        local holding = p138.values.holding;

        if holding then
            if p138.states.holding:get() == p138.values.holding.instance then
                holding = p138.values.holding.loadout_type == "primary";
            else
                holding = false;
            end;
        end;

        safety:set_instant(holding);

        return;
    end;

    p137.states.sights:set(false);
    p137:reload(p138, false);
    p137:cock(p138, false);
    p137.sound.Handle(Root);
    p138.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_pivot("equipped");

    if p137.safety:get() == false then
        p138.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_pivot("equipped");
        p138.values.cframes:get("arm2"):remove_absolute("equipped");
    end;

    p137.safety:set_instant(nil);

    if p138.values.holding and p138.values.holding.safety then
        p138.values.holding.safety:set(false);
    end;

    p137.anim.Equip.arm1_grab(_absolute).Completed:Wait();
    p137.cframes:get(Root).pivot_time = 0.2;
    p137.cframes:get(Root):remove_pivot("equipped");
    p138.values.cframes:get("arm1"):remove_absolute("equipped");
    p137:holster(p138);
end;

function get_circular_spread(p184, p185)
    local v186 = math.random() * 2 * 3.141592653589793;
